note: Invesco DB Gold (DGL): REAL gold-futures fund (futures + T-bill collateral, ~0.75-0.78%/yr ER). Used to REALIZE the futures-vs-spot carry gap: DGL_TR - GLD_TR ~= lease - ER_DGL + ER_GLD, so realized lease ~= (DGL-GLD) + 0.78% - 0.40%. Brief lists lease rates as optional Phase 0 data; this is the measurement instrument chosen (documented amendment: extra ticker, same endpoint).
